svg.aria-label: The Krishna Chronicle. Local engineer deletes 30-minute task; factory quietly asks for more. KANCHIPURAM — He arrived at Indo Tech Transformers to test them: ratio, vector group, SFRA, partial discharge, the full IEC 60076 drill. Then he noticed how much of the plant still ran on paper, phone calls and copy-paste. Witnesses say he went quiet. Months later, dispatch, testing, hiring and attendance run on software he wrote. The habit is not new. As an intern at Bühler India he built a Python tool that turned thirty minutes of MCC paperwork into thirty seconds. Before that: a patent filing for street lights that follow the car, a #7 national rank among 1500+ colleges at IIT Bombay, and a B.E. Electrical & Electronics from St. Joseph's College of Engineering (CGPA 8.38).
